title: ～がち
shortExplanation: Expresses that something tends to occur frequently or habitually.
longExplanation: The ～がち grammar point is used to express that something has a tendency to occur frequently or habitually. It can be attached to verbs and adjectives to indicate that the action or state tends to occur often.
formation: Verb-ます stem + がち / い-Adjective stem + がち / な-Adjective stem + がち

examples.jp: 彼は風邪を引きがちです。
examples.romaji: Kare wa kaze o hiki-gachi desu.
examples.en: He tends to catch colds easily.

examples.jp: この地域は雨が降りがちです。
examples.romaji: Kono chiiki wa ame ga furi-gachi desu.
examples.en: This area tends to get a lot of rain.

examples.jp: 彼女は忘れ物をしがちです。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa wasuremono o shi-gachi desu.

examples.jp: 私は遅刻しがちなので、もっと早く起きないといけません。
examples.romaji: Watashi wa chikoku shi-gachi na no de, motto hayaku okinai to ikemasen.
examples.en: I tend to be late, so I need to wake up earlier.

words.surface: 起きないといけません
words.reading: おきないといけません
